title: TurnStructuredOutput
description: Strict shape for the canonical Message.content of primary_turn and branch_turn messages. The runtime canonicalizes a provider's `structured_output` into this shape before appending to the canonical_transcript; any extra fields a provider returns are discarded. `additionalProperties` is false so no out-of-band field (e.g. an `@AgentName` mention reintroduced as a side channel) can persist into the canonical_transcript.

text.description: The agent's free-form turn content (natural language). The runtime does not parse this string for control signals (ADR-003).

direct_requests.description: Zero or more structured inter-agent control signals (ADR-003). The only sanctioned form of addressing another agent.
